1.explanation: This minimal React app uses carbon-components-react’s DataTable with only the TableToolbar and TableToolbarSearch. By default, TableToolbarSearch attaches role="searchbox" and aria-label="Filter table" to the containing div but does not render a visible label on the input itself. In JAWS (v2019.1906.10) under Firefox ESR 60.8, the aria-label on a div with role=“searchbox” is not announced, so the search field is exposed to the screen reader only by the button’s aria-label ("Edit"), leading to "Unlabeled Edit" or "? Edit" announcements. Loading this code and inspecting with JAWS reproduces the bug.
1.bug_scenario:
When rendering a DataTable with only the TableToolbarSearch inside a TableToolbar (using carbon-components-react v7.5.1), the outer container div is given role="searchbox" and an aria-label, but JAWS in Firefox ESR does not announce the aria-label. Instead it announces “Unlabeled Edit” or “? Edit” (the label for the magnifier button) as the name of the search field.

In the simulated example below you can reproduce the issue: the search container receives the aria-label “Filter table”, yet JAWS does not read it, and only reads the icon button label.
